citations.assessment: The Ifa entry reciprocally refers to this dossier and reports study of Shevuot in Rabbah’s academy. It describes a separate encounter.
Names the three learners at Rabbah’s academy and begins Rav Kahana’s encounter. This witness has bar Huna and calls Yitzchak’s father Rav Yehudah.
Rava bar Ittai addresses them about the oath of deposit.
Names Safra, Acha bar Huna, Huna bar Chinena and Abaye together in the discussion of divorce documentation.
Names the first three together on moving bowls. Abaye is absent from this parallel grouping.
Acha bar Huna asks Rav Sheshet about the scope of an exception in a sale. A second version asks about half the tree.
Acha asks about a student who fell silent after saying he could argue for acquittal. Rav Sheshet makes the gesture that Rashi takes to express dismissal of the question.
Acha bar Rav Huna reports Rav Sheshet on tefillin.
Acha son of Rav Huna reports Rav Sheshet’s proverb about satiety.
Acha bar Rav Huna reports Rav Sheshet’s distinction concerning the camel.
Acha bar Huna submits the betrothal question to Rav Yosef and receives a response.
Acha bar Rav Huna addresses Rav Nachman directly.
The story takes place before Rav Chisda, but the speaker praising Acha is Rava.
Rav Chisda sends a question through Acha bar Rav Huna to Rabbah.
Acha bar Rav Huna raises a refutation to Rava in the meal-offering discussion.
Acha bar Rav Huna presents the apparent contradiction to Rava.
Rava instructs Acha bar Huna and Safra to enlist two non-Jews and oversee the offering. Heilprin says that Rava sent the two to arrange the offering and abbreviates the delegation.
The inspected witness reads bar Huna. Heilprin proposes inserting Rav before Huna, in keeping with the heading and multiple other passages.
